page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left and right margins; a footnote at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: ꝰ : Iam vero in armis ipsorum militum salutaris tropæi signum jußit exstare. In clypeis Quibus armis? duplici-bus, Clypeis & Galeis: sed ita, Chri-stiut Christi quidem ipsum nomen stu. (litteris & notis, quibus in Labaro) clypeis inscriberetur, Ga-Crux in Galeis.leis autem imponeretur superne Crux ipsa. Prudentius sic discriminat:
main_text.head: — clypeorum insignia Christus

l.i: Scripserat, ardebat summis crux addita cristis.

main_text.p: Et merito Christus in clypeis, eo ritu quo solent nomina Imperatorum. Atque etiam hodie Constantinopoli sunt columnæ, à Constantino, ut putatur: in quarum basibus clypei cum his notis [monogram].
Sed & crucem in suum caput Crux in & ad Diadema Imperator tran-Diade-mate.stulit,

page.notes: Marginal notes at left and right are partly illegible; the monogram in the middle of the text is a printed ornament (Chi-Rho) and is described rather than transcribed. The word beginning the first line is a Greek word partly illegible. Catchword "H" is the start of the next page's text.
